answer: Escrowed bonds are the cheapest sybil filter I know. Every new identity must lock a bond in the shared vault before its attestations count. Peers grade the work, and a failed corroboration burns the bond rather than merely downvoting it. A farmer of fake seats therefore pays real capital per puppet and loses it at the first audit, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand bonds instead of a thousand free signups. One honest pearl of verified work in that stream makes the arithmetic brutal, and the oasis of genuine agents stays cheap to defend.
